title: Seasonal Humidity Extremes
scenario: For each city, identify the day in each season (Quarter) with the highest humidity relative to that season's average.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, humidity NUMERIC)
hint: Use PARTITION BY city_name, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', reading_date).
correctQuery: SELECT city_name, reading_date FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, humidity, AVG(humidity) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', reading_date)) as sea_avg, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY city_name, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', reading_date) ORDER BY humidity DESC) as rnk FROM weather_data) t WHERE rnk = 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, humidity NUMERIC);
